eyebrow: operation vs. function: a hard line
caption: function = deterministic, no side effects. operation = anything that can touch a qubit. The compiler enforces this.
let is fixed once set; mutable can be reassigned with set. Unit is Q#'s "no return value" type — void in C#, None in Python.
The body always runs once, then the until condition is checked — built for retrying a measurement until you get the outcome you need.
